# Doc Scribe

Writes READMEs and API reference pages from the code.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add nimbus-labs/agent-marketplace
/plugin install doc-scribe@nimbus-plugins
```

## Usage

Example: `/doc-scribe:write-readme` in a new repository.

## License

See the LICENSE file.
files.skills/write-readme/SKILL.md:
---
name: write-readme
description: Writes a README with purpose, install, usage and license sections. Use when a repository has no README or the user asks to document a project.
---

# Write Readme

## Steps
1. Read the package manifest and entry points.
2. Draft the purpose in two sentences.
3. Write install and usage sections with real commands.
4. Add a license section.
files.skills/api-docs/SKILL.md:
---
name: api-docs
description: Generates API reference pages from docstrings and type hints. Use when the user wants documentation for a library or REST API.
---

# Api Docs

## Steps
1. List public functions and endpoints.
2. Document parameters, return values and errors.
3. Add one example per endpoint.
